admin.title: Command stations
admin.subtitle: DCC command-station catalogue. Attach stations to layouts from the layout edit dialog.

supervisord.title: dcc-bus service — {{name}}
supervisord.noPrograms: No dcc-bus programs for this command station

wizard.title: Connection wizard
wizard.lead: The wizard discovers available command stations and walks you through basic setup. Advanced settings (timing, speed steps) can be changed later on the command-station list.
wizard.scanning: Scanning… this may take up to about a minute
wizard.scanAlreadyRunning: A scan is already running. Wait for it to finish or refresh the page.
wizard.empty: No command stations found. Check power, USB cable / network, and scan again.
wizard.autodetectWarning: This connection uses dynamic device detection on every server and computer restart. The port number may change, or detection may eventually fail (for example if a second USB adapter appears). Prefer a concrete device path when available.
wizard.skipHint: Turn the switch off to add the station to the catalogue only and attach it later when editing a layout.

select.label: Select
select.title: Detected connections
select.instruction: BigFred scans the local network and serial ports for possible command-station connections. If you are unsure about baud rate or address, pick the most familiar option — you can change it later. Recommended baud rate for DR5000, RB1110, and YamoRC YD7001: 115200. Check your command station's documentation or ask an AI assistant (e.g. Google Gemini) with your exact model name.

remotes.label: Handsets
remotes.title: Z21 and WiFred handsets
remotes.instruction: Enable control from WiFred/LongFred and ROCO WlanMaus/Z21 handsets.
remotes.unavailable: External handsets cannot connect to BigFred running on a phone. Use the BigFred app on this device instead.

bootstop.label: Boot-stop
bootstop.title: Boot-stop
bootstop.instruction: Boot-stop is a one-shot emergency stop of all layout vehicles right after dcc-bus starts. Useful when you do not want locomotives to resume their previous speed after a restart. Any change to command-station settings restarts the connection, which also triggers boot-stop.
bootstop.alert: With boot-stop enabled, every BigFred / dcc-bus restart will emergency-stop vehicles.

slots.label: Slots
slots.title: LocoNet slot allocation
slots.instruction: When enabled, BigFred claims a slot like a physical FRED and will not take a locomotive driven by another throttle. On by default. You can disable this if you do not use other wired throttles. When BigFred is the only throttle in use, physical slot allocation is not needed — BigFred handles slots internally and enforces access control.

layout.label: Layout
layout.title: Attach to layout
layout.instruction: The station is added to the system catalogue. You can attach it to the current layout now or skip and do it later in layout edit.
layout.warning: A layout should only have the 1–2 command stations that are actually used. Do not attach stations that are not connected, to avoid overloading the system. Do not add the same station twice via different connection methods — that can have unpredictable effects.

delete.title: Delete command station "{{name}}"
delete.message: This cannot be undone. The station will be detached from every layout it was attached to.

fields.name: Name
fields.speedStepsHelp: DCC speed resolution forwarded to dcc-bus. Default 128.
fields.pollIntervalMsHelp: State-feed polling cadence for drivers without push. 0 uses the daemon default (750 ms).
fields.heartbeatSecsHelp: WebSocket ping interval. Default 2 s. If the ping does not arrive before the dead-man, the vehicle will be emergency-stopped.
fields.deadmanSecsHelp: Idle window after which the daemon applies emergency stop. Must be longer than the heartbeat. Default 6 s.
fields.z21ServerEnabledHelp: Supports WlanMaus, the Z21 app, RailBox Railroad Control, and other clients that speak the ROCO Z21 protocol.
fields.z21IpStickiness: Session bound to IP (IP stickiness — note: read the help below)
fields.z21IpStickinessHelp: When enabled, the handset session is bound to the client IP, not the UDP port — more convenient for users. After a reconnect with a new port (common with DHCP) pairing stays active. Important! Your router must use IP stickiness or assign fixed IPs to handsets manually, otherwise another handset may receive an IP previously used by another user's handset and could control their vehicles!
fields.z21ServerDisableWarn: Disabling the server stops new pairings. Active handset sessions stop working after the dcc-bus daemon restarts.
fields.withrottleServerEnabledHelp: Supports WiFred, LongFred, Engine Driver, other physical throttles, and phone apps that use the WiThrottle protocol.
fields.withrottleServerDisableWarn: Disabling the server stops new pairings. Active WiFred sessions stop working after the dcc-bus daemon restarts.
fields.maxLoconetSlotsHelp: How many slots BigFred may lease on this command station; the rest stay free for physical throttles. Default 80.
fields.allocatePhysicalSlotsHelp: When on (default), BigFred claims exclusive IN_USE like a physical FRED — it cannot take a loco another throttle already drives, and a FRED cannot take one BigFred holds. When off, BigFred may share a slot already held by a FRED (legacy piggyback). Changing this restarts dcc-bus.
fields.idleTimeoutSecsHelp: After this idle period a remote handset (WlanMaus/Z21/WiFred) loses its slot. 0 disables idle release. Default 60 s.
fields.bootStopEnabledHelp: When enabled, dcc-bus sends emergency stop to every vehicle in the system once after start.
fields.singleVehicleControl: Only one vehicle can be controlled at a time
fields.singleVehicleControlHelp: When enabled, selecting or driving a different vehicle or consist stops the user's other moving vehicles (speed > 1). Lent-out vehicles are not stopped.

slotsDiag.title: DCC-Bus slot diagnostics
slotsDiag.subtitle: Advanced view — monitor slot behaviour, see limits, and release any slot if needed.
slotsDiag.unlimitedSlots: {{used}} active leases (no LocoNet budget on this station)
slotsDiag.releaseConfirm: Release the slot for address {{addr}}? The locomotive will be emergency-stopped.
